items.t: Is Sandoz Group (SWX:SDZ) Stock Stretched Or Reasonable On Cash Flow?
items.sum: Sandoz Group has ridden a powerful share price run, and the question now is whether the current level can be backed up by the cash the business is expected to generate. With cash flows in focus, investors are asking if the recent enthusiasm lines up with what the underlying operations can reasonably support.
